title: Bounded complexes with finite cohomology modules
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $D(A)$ be the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian category of $A$-modules; for $K\in D(A)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$ write $H^i(K)$ for its $i$-th cohomology module. Define

$$
 D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)\subset D(A)
$$

to be the full subcategory of the objects $K$ such that $H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i$ and every $H^i(K)$ is a finite set.

source.place: the definition of $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n})$ in the statement
